ambient_events: A groundskeeper picks ticket stubs out of a flowerbed one at a time.
Somebody eats a hot dog on a bench and watches the Coliseum wall.
A pigeon lands on the nearest lamp and looks at you.
description: North Plaza under the Coliseum's north wall, with a bronze lamp standard every few steps. Hughson Way comes down to the paving from the north and stops.
name: North Plaza
